translations.web: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.
translations.bsb: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.
translations.kjv: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
translations.asv: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.
